evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked the formal agenda line, but the customer's real concern (the gym equipment 'Sana' needing disassembly) surfaced organically at the top of the call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Went genuinely deep on the Sana concern — requested a photo, checked the weight, asked 'would you be able to disassemble it in advance,' looped in a branch manager, came back with an answer, then asked 'would that be a deal breaker if we won't be able to disassemble it for you?'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'this is just an estimate, the preliminary estimate, you are not the bound by the numbers... you only pay for the actual time' covers the window/not-bound-by-the-number framing; no rate-commit, beats-it-pay-less, self-prep tip, or fairness check were said.

top_strength: Handled the ambiguous gym-equipment item with real diligence — checked with the branch manager live on the call rather than guessing, which builds trust on an edge case.
coaching_note: Call ends on 'I'll email you the estimate' with no rate-lock line and no explicit ask to book — after doing the hard work of resolving the Sana question, close the loop by asking directly for the business or setting a concrete next step.
